hourly.summary: The forum is buzzing with pre-match nerves and excitement ahead of Arsenal's title showdown with Manchester City at the Emirates. Fans are poring over team news (Raya's fitness, Saliba's return), debating line-ups (Guimarães vs Gyökeres), and dreaming of landing Brazilian wonderkid Estevão. The mention of Arsenal pocketing £1.4bn as reigning champions adds a layer of 'we've arrived' swagger, but the dominant mood is the jittery anticipation of a season-defining afternoon.

daily.summary: Arsenal fan sentiment shifted markedly from morning tentativeness to evening euphoria, moving from post-Dortmund anxiety and squad-depth worries to pure, buzzing anticipation for Sunday's title showdown at the Etihad. The day's arc reflects the classic pre-big-game emotional rollercoaster — nerves giving way to nostalgic confidence and rivalry-fueled excitement as kickoff approaches. By nightfall, the dominant mood was uncut anticipation: top of the table, November, City away — this is why they do it.

weekly.summary: After riding a wave of euphoric confidence through mid-week — fueled by contract extensions, academy breakthroughs, and table-topping form — Arsenal fan sentiment collapsed dramatically over the weekend. A catastrophic Newcastle draw, Raya's injury scare, and the women's team's managerial crisis triggered a plunge from near-peak optimism (9/10) to structural anxiety (4/10), leaving the fanbase convinced their fragile lead could evaporate at any moment.
